headline: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam gets its date
title: Professor Layton New World of Steam December 10 | Release Date | Gaming News
video_script: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam finally has a release date. It launches on December tenth, twenty twenty six, from developer Level Five. The puzzle adventure comes to PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PC. The date was revealed during the September ninth Nintendo Direct. Will you solve the mystery? Comment below!
